Ivao.$comment.urls: These three must match, character for character, what is registered with IVAO for this client. Same scheme, host and port for all of them; locally that is http://localhost:5173.
Ivao.$comment.Scopes: What a member is asked for when they sign in. 'profile' is what brings their real name; without it the site knows a VID and nothing else.
Ivao.$comment.ApiScopes: What the application asks for itself, with client_credentials, to read data that belongs to nobody in particular. Measured on 3 September 2026: the reference endpoints need no scope at all, so leave this empty until something asks for one.
